title: The Burial of the Guns
author: Thomas Nelson Page
description: "The Burial of the Guns" by Thomas Nelson Page is a historical fiction novel likely written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: It delves into the aftermath of the Civil War, focusing on the emotional and social ramifications of surrender and the transition back to civilian life, particularly through the experiences of Southern soldiers and their commanders. The opening introduces readers to complex characters, such as the old Colonel and his battery of soldiers, who grapple with pride, duty, and the loss of their former identities as they face the end of the war.

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Nelson Page was an American lawyer, politician, and writer. He served as the U.S. ambassador to Italy from 1913 to 1919 under the administration of President Woodrow Wilson during World War I.
